name: ChatGPT dots
tagline: Always-on personal agents with their own computer, handle and face.
description: Announced at OpenAI DevDay 2026, dots are persistent agents that each own a cloud computer and browser you can watch and take over. They wake themselves on schedules, events or their own judgement, keep their own notes, ask before risky actions under per-action autonomy rules with a mandatory auto-review, and have a name, @handle and avatar. Stack inferred from public reporting.
